title: How pkg/tsdb tests are structured (unit + golden files)
answers: How do I run tests for pkg/tsdb?
How are query response regressions tested in pkg/tsdb?
Where do golden test fixtures live?
body: Standard Go table-driven tests live colocated as `*_test.go` next to the code (e.g. pkg/tsdb/graphite/query_test.go), run via `go test ./pkg/tsdb/...` or `make test-go-unit`. Response-shape regression tests use grafana-plugin-sdk-go/experimental.CheckGoldenJSONResponse against fixtures in each package's testdata/ directory (e.g. pkg/tsdb/graphite/query_test.go:743 writes/compares `testdata/<testName>-<refId>.golden`). Golden-file usage is limited (~4 call sites found across pkg/tsdb) — most coverage is plain unit tests, not golden diffs.
